game_name: Fatal Fury Special / Garou Densetsu Special (NGM-058 ~ NGH-058, set 2)
general_issues: Select fatfurspa.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
